title: Crumple
description: A real film photo print, Kodak's sun hats on a wall, lying on the table. Press and hold and it slowly scrunches into a faceted paper ball under the lamp; let go and it eases back open, flat again but covered in the creases it just learned.
intent: Realistic paper, slow and eased: a cloth simulation with plastic bending is baked offline into a crumple and an uncrumple path, and a critically damped spring scrubs between them so every press, release and change of mind stays continuous.
sources: Print photo: kodim03 (hats), a 35mm film scan from Kodak Photo CD PCD0992, released by the Eastman Kodak Company for unrestricted usage; via https://github.com/MohamedBakrAli/Kodak-Lossless-True-Color-Image-Suite (mirror of http://r0k.us/graphics/kodak/), cropped square and re-encoded as webp.
